texts.zh: 看来[target.GetName]上的奴隶们已经无法再忍受下去了，他们开始绝食抗议。奴隶团体的发言人告诉我们，一大批奴隶开始拒绝摄入任何食物，直到我们废除奴隶制为止。到目前为止我们强迫他们进食的尝试均已失败。令人遗憾的是营养不良将大大的降低他们的工作效率。
texts.en: It would seem that the slaves on [target.GetName] have had enough...to eat. Spokespersons have informed us that a large number of slaves will be refusing all intake of food till we abolish slavery planetwide. So far all our attempts to force-feed them have failed. Sadly nutritional deficiencies will be expected to lower their work performance significantly.

label.en: We need to resolve our issues.
